cmd:
set -e
cd /opt/trading-bot
echo '' | base64 -d > swings_web.py
chown tbot:tbot swings_web.py
ss -ltn | grep -c ':8093 ' || true
cat > /etc/systemd/system/swingsweb.service <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Swings web page (min/max profit per position)
After=network.target

[Service]
User=tbot
WorkingDirectory=/opt/trading-bot
ExecStart=/opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python /opt/trading-bot/swings_web.py
Restart=always
RestartSec=5

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now swingsweb
sleep 3
systemctl is-active swingsweb
echo "--- новая база:"; curl -s "http://127.0.0.1:8093/?db=new" | python3 -c "import sys,re;t=sys.stdin.read();print(len(t),'байт;', re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',t)[:700])"
echo "--- старая:"; curl -s "http://127.0.0.1:8093/?db=old" | python3 -c "import sys,re;t=sys.stdin.read();print(len(t),'байт;', re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',t)[:500])"
systemctl is-active wallbot
